notes.title: Game Updates Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you for your support of our “Hundred Demons Try Zen Heart”, we have received the affirmation and feedback from the first batch of players, and we will continue to make more efforts.



In response to players' bug feedback, we have done the first time to fix the update.

July 20 Update Log

1. Optimized the display of character goodwill.

2. Fixed the problem of missing multi-languages in the game.

3. Optimized the problem of overlapping voices in the game.

4. Optimized the story line of some character endings.

5. Fixed the problem of abnormal function of some options in the game.

6. Added multi-language translation in the game.

7. Optimized the unlock conditions for game endings.



July 21st update log

1. Fixed the problem of abnormal function of some options in the game.

2. Added multi-language translation in the game.

3. Optimized the unlock conditions for game endings.
